summary: Customer settlement first slice: settlement of 1..n complete unconsumed approved term rows with term-derived integer amounts and cumulative HALF_UP conservation, active open items split into due/retention partitions, read-only aging pools, six routes/templates, two named read-only cross-owner interfaces, settlement integrity branch and SQLite/PostgreSQL guards. Cash clearing, credit/bad debt, AP, invoices, disputes, reversal and opening items remain future tasks.

review.reviewer: independent PH-224 implementation reviewer (fresh context, read-only; multi-round)
findings: Blocking plugin-dependency regression (two SQLite tests + two PostgreSQL concurrency setUps) was fixed first by the PH-226 pre-task; PH-224 was rebased onto that BASE and the full suite is green (680 OK, 40 environment skips).

MAJOR replay: save_settlement queries the receipt before period/derive checks and normalizes the default settled_on digest, so same-token replay after lock or across midnight returns the original settlement; regression tests and browser probe both pass.
MAJOR evidence: refs are canonical three-key objects; free-text basis stays in the private terms_snapshot/evidence_note and is displayed via evidence_display.

Browser defects found by real-browser evidence were fixed and re-verified on final HEAD: aging due/release date rendering, readable source refs (detail and form), draft edit pre-check of already selected terms.

Retained minor limitations (documented in unverified): verify_integrity does not check item tax total/occurred_on/approved digest/claim source/one event per item; no canonical Settlement/OpenItem projection; string vs dict term_refs produce different receipt digests; review return/reject still requires an open period; 32 pre-existing urls.W003 warnings; browser Chromium-only; PostgreSQL races and production/UAT unverified.
review.evidence: Reviewer reran the full suite (680 OK), the 35 targeted tests (6 PG skip), check/makemigrations, the three contract scripts, verify_integrity on the fresh/populated/legacy and real-settlement browser databases (all ok:true), parsed the browser evidence (57/57, HEAD matches), and audited the diff against PH-224 allowed paths. Formal PASS is conditional on the PR PostgreSQL CI executing the 6 settlement concurrency tests successfully. Final condition satisfied: PR #121 PostgreSQL domain check passed with all 12 required checks SUCCESS at HEAD 7c65bcc, covering the 6 settlement concurrency tests.

deviations: PH-226 (test prerequisite) was merged first so the settlement plugin's contracts/delivery dependency edge does not break two existing SQLite tests and two PostgreSQL concurrency setUp blocks; PH-224 was rebased onto that BASE.

Module-disabled HTTP routes return 403 while settlement history remains readable through the service layer; this matches other plugins and is the intended 'history readable' reading (spec service-layer read, not public route).

Term keys are frozen as coverage_key='term:<due|retention>:<term_id>' and partition_key='<due|retention>:<term_id>' with source_id=contract_line_id, matching the frozen spec semantics despite the earlier 'kind' wording ambiguity.
Settlement evidence refs are restricted to canonical {evidence_id, sha256, kind}; the free-text basis stays in the private terms_snapshot/evidence_note and the UI displays evidence_display.

Browser evidence on final HEAD 9566481: 57/57 checks pass, 0 failures; three defects found and fixed (aging due/release date rendering, source ref readability, draft edit pre-check of selected terms).

PostgreSQL CI (PR #121, HEAD 7c65bcc): all 12 required checks pass, including the PostgreSQL domain job actually executing the 6 settlement concurrency tests; the earlier PG-only failure was the receipt immutability trigger raising a generic ProgrammingError instead of an integrity-class error, fixed by a dedicated 23514 trigger function in migration 0002.
unverified: PostgreSQL concurrency/lock/period-race execution is provided by the PR's PostgreSQL CI job; local SQLite skips are not evidence.
Production/customer UAT, cash clearing, credit/bad debt, AP, invoices, disputes, active-settlement reversal, opening items and AgingCase writes are out of this slice.
Browser evidence covers Chromium 320/390/768/1024/1440 only; printing, dark mode, touch and non-Chromium browsers untested.
verify_integrity does not yet check per-item tax total, occurred_on equality, draft/submitted emptiness, approved_input digest, claim source/event_ref, or exactly one canonical event per item.
No canonical Settlement/OpenItem projection exists yet; snapshots are private view dicts.
String vs dict term_refs are both accepted and yield different receipt digests for the same semantics (same token across representations conflicts, low risk).
Review return/reject also requires an open accounting period (consistent with acceptance precedent, a policy choice rather than a defect).
PostgreSQL concurrency, production/customer UAT, cash clearing, credit/bad debt, AP, invoices, disputes, reversal and opening items remain unverified.
